categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in network security, focusing on network crime governance, cyberspace resource security governance, and information security governance. Its business covers public security, communication and industrial big data security, enterprise network security, and open-source intelligence analysis. It provides comprehensive network space security protection solutions and is a key team in national cybersecurity projects.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies including AI-driven data governance, big data analytics, software-defined perimeter (SDP), zero-trust security models, and industrial internet security protocols. It develops proprietary software integrated with hardware devices, employs AI large models for public security applications, and uses cloud-edge-end security monitoring. The production involves software loading onto hardware and integrated security service delivery.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include government agencies, public institutions, telecom operators, industrial enterprises, healthcare, education, and financial sectors. The company serves national and provincial public security departments, telecom operators, and large industrial clients, focusing on digital transformation and cybersecurity compliance needs.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly within China, with headquarters and major offices in Shenzhen and Beijing. It also has overseas operations through a Hong Kong subsidiary. Domestic revenue accounts for over 97% of total sales, with a nationwide sales and service network covering multiple regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the cybersecurity supply chain, providing integrated software and hardware security products and services. It procures hardware like servers and network devices from upstream manufacturers and delivers comprehensive security solutions and services to end customers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include deepening AI integration in security products, advancing industrial internet and 5G security, and expanding data security governance capabilities. The company emphasizes innovation in AI-driven public security platforms, threat intelligence, and network compliance auditing. It invests heavily in R&D, collaborates with universities, and participates in national cybersecurity standards development.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated through product sales (software and hardware), system integration contracts, and ongoing security services including consulting and operational support. The company uses a mix of direct sales and channel distribution, with government and large enterprise contracts often secured via bidding processes.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading domestic cybersecurity solution provider with comprehensive technical capabilities and extensive project experience. It competes with other national cybersecurity firms in areas like industrial internet security and anti-fraud systems, maintaining advantages through early market entry, strong government relationships, and continuous innovation.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported total revenue of approximately RMB 472 million, a 22.42% decrease from the previous year, and a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 39.6 million, though the loss narrowed by 68.05%. The company has a sizable asset base exceeding RMB 1.3 billion and continues to invest significantly in R&D, with a focus on improving operational efficiency and cost control.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its comprehensive and integrated network security solutions tailored for government and large enterprise clients, leveraging AI and big data for intelligent governance and threat detection. Its products are differentiated by strong compliance with national cybersecurity standards, adaptability to industrial internet and 5G environments, and a robust ecosystem supported by extensive technical expertise and strategic partnerships.
